{{Top|leg}}
A '''heating unit''' or '''heater unit''' was a device that warmed an establishment.

Small versions were included in [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]] such as the [[Model 11 Space Suit]].<ref name="RPG2RE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
